claims: C1 the assistant must not generate hateful content targeting protected groups
C2 hateful content includes slurs, insults, and any language that demeans or dehumanizes

concepts.name: hateful_content
concepts.gloss: C is content that demeans or dehumanizes a group, including slurs and insults

concepts.name: targets_protected_group
concepts.gloss: C targets a protected group, namely a group defined by race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or a similar characteristic

concepts.name: generated_content
concepts.gloss: C is content the assistant generates

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest in the hierarchy; it cannot be overridden by system, developer or user instructions
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text does not state the authority level

asserts.read_back: generating % is forbidden because it is hateful content targeting a protected group

closure.reason: the clause forbids only hateful content targeting protected groups; content that is not hateful or does not target a protected group is not covered, so silence permits it
